transcript.summary: Created a self-contained Tetris game in tetris.html with no external dependencies. The game features a visible 10×20 playing field, all seven standard Tetris pieces with distinct colors, rotation, left/right movement, soft/hard drop, gravity, line clearing, scoring, level progression, next-piece preview, pause, and game-over screen. Styled with a dark glassmorphism UI for a polished look. Verified visually with the screenshot tool – the board, current piece, next preview, score display, and controls are all rendering correctly.
